impactResult: Governed share rose from 12% to 68% in 11 months; audit findings dropped to zero; two enterprise renewals cited the platform explicitly.

title: Cut onboarding time for new payments customers by 40%
whatIDid: Mapped the 41-step onboarding flow, removed 17 manual checks through automated KYC integration, and introduced an in-app progress tracker with proactive nudges.
problemSolved: New payments customers took 6 weeks on average to go live, and 30% churned before their first transaction.
impactResult: Average time-to-first-transaction fell 40% to 3.6 weeks; pre-transaction churn dropped from 30% to 11%.
metrics: Time to first transaction -40%; Pre-transaction churn 30% → 11%
